story.iWant: to track before/after metrics for recommendations I've implemented
story.soThat: I can see if changes actually improved my conversion rates

task.description: Create Implementation Tracking page or filter
task.subtasks: - Add "Implemented" filter to src/app/(dashboard)/dashboard/recommendations/page.tsx - Query recommendations with status="IMPLEMENTED" from Prisma - Sort by implementation date (most recent first) - Display empty state if no implemented recommendations - Pass filtered data to ImplementedRecommendationsList component

- Create src/components/dashboard/implemented-recommendation-card.tsx as Client Component - Display implementation date with relative time - Calculate time since implementation for status determination - Show before/after metrics (conversion rate, cart abandonment rate) - Calculate change percentage with positive/negative indicators - Show status badge (Too early, Positive trend, No change, Negative trend) - Style with Bold Purple theme and semantic colors

- Create src/services/analytics/implementation-tracker.ts - Implement calculateBeforeMetrics (7 days pre-implementation) - Implement calculateAfterMetrics (7 days post-implementation) - Implement calculateMetricChange (percentage with trend direction) - Add unit tests for all calculation functions

- Create src/components/dashboard/metric-trend-chart.tsx as Client Component - Use Recharts for line chart (14-day period: 7 before + 7 after) - Show vertical line indicator for implementation date - Plot conversion rate and cart abandonment trend lines - Add tooltips with exact values - Responsive chart sizing with purple accent colors

- Create celebration component for positive results (≥10% improvement) - Show confetti animation or visual success indicator - Display congratulations message - Add optional share button - Make celebration dismissible with localStorage - Trigger once per recommendation per session

- Add implementationNotes field to Recommendation model - Create Server Action: updateImplementationNotes - Build notes editor component with Textarea - Display existing notes below metrics - Auto-save on blur or manual save - 500 character limit

- Add implementationNotes: String? field to Recommendation model - Ensure implementedAt: DateTime? field exists - Generate Prisma migration - Apply migration to database - Update TypeScript types from Prisma client

- Test querying recommendations filtered by IMPLEMENTED status - Test before/after metrics calculation with mock data - Test edge cases: <7 days, insufficient data - Test metric change calculation scenarios - Test implementation notes CRUD - Place tests in tests/integration/dashboard/implementation-tracking.test.ts

task.description: Handle edge cases and loading states
task.subtasks: - Show "Too early to measure" badge if <7 days - Handle missing session data gracefully - Warn about confidence during low-traffic periods - Display loading skeleton while fetching - Error handling with retry option

task.description: Style with Bold Purple theme and responsive layout
task.subtasks: - Apply theme colors: purple (#7c3aed), green (#10b981), red (#ef4444), amber (#fbbf24) - Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all indicators - Responsive card layout: stacked on mobile, side-by-side on desktop - Chart responsive: full width mobile, max 600px desktop

- Add ARIA labels for metric changes - Verify keyboard navigation - Ensure trend indicators have text labels (not color alone) - Screen reader test for metric changes and status - Verify chart tooltips are keyboard accessible - Add semantic HTML for comparison tables

criterion.description: "Implemented" tab/filter shows all implemented recommendations with status

criterion.details: - Implementation date - Before metrics (conversion rate, cart abandonment rate from pre-implementation period) - After metrics (same metrics from post-implementation period) - Change percentage (with positive/negative indicators) - Time since implementation

criterion.description: Automatic calculation of before/after periods (7 days before vs 7 days after implementation)
Visual charts showing metric trends over time
Status indicators: "Too early to measure" (<7 days), "Positive trend", "No change detected", "Negative trend"
Success celebrations for positive results (visual feedback, optional share)
Ability to add notes about implementation experience

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: System shall allow users to mark recommendations as "Implemented," "Dismissed," or "Planned" and track before/after metrics for implemented changes

doc.title: Epic 2: Dashboard & User Experience
doc.snippet: Complete story specification with 7 acceptance criteria: Implemented tab/filter, before/after metrics display (implementation date, conversion rate, cart abandonment), automatic 7-day period calculation, visual trend charts, status indicators (too early/positive/negative trend), success celebrations, and implementation notes

doc.title: Technical Architecture
doc.snippet: Story 2.6 Implementation Tracking: Before/after metrics calculation, trend visualization components. Key architecture challenge: high-volume time-series data processing and before/after impact measurement

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Implementation tracking pattern follows task management UX (Planned → In Progress → Done). Mark as Implemented flow includes date picker, system tracks before/after metrics, status changes to "Tracking Results". Results shown 7-14 days later with email notification. Before/after metrics tracking uses celebratory but data-driven feedback approach

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Uses task management pattern (similar to Asana, Todoist) with before/after metrics tracking. Feedback should be celebratory but data-driven showing clear metrics

doc.title: Testing Strategy
doc.snippet: Integration tests use Vitest 4.0 with test database, located in tests/integration/**/*.test.ts. Should test API endpoints, Server Actions, service layer integration, and database operations. Target 80%+ coverage for critical services

doc.title: Story 2.3: Recommendation Detail View
doc.snippet: Includes implementation date picker when marking as implemented. Recommendation status changes reflected immediately. Sets implementedAt field on Recommendation model

doc.title: Story 2.5: Peer Benchmarks Tab
doc.snippet: Service layer pattern from src/services/analytics/peer-calculator.ts provides metrics calculation reference. Uses journeyPath array analysis for cart/checkout/conversion detection. Includes confidence levels based on session count thresholds

Metrics calculation service pattern to reuse. Shows how to calculate conversion rate, cart abandonment from Session.journeyPath arrays. Reference pattern for implementation-tracker.ts service
Existing Server Action that sets implementedAt and implementationNotes. Already used by Story 2.3. Need to add updateImplementationNotes action for editing notes separately

Recommendation model already has implementedAt (line 116) and implementationNotes (line 117) fields. Session model has journeyPath, converted, bounced for metrics calculation. Index on [siteId, createdAt] for efficient date-range queries
Existing card component pattern for recommendations list. Reference for creating ImplementedRecommendationCard with similar structure but different data display
Visual comparison pattern for metrics with before/after structure. Reference for displaying metric changes with semantic colors (green/red)

node.required: recharts (NOT INSTALLED - needs: npm install recharts)
shadcn/ui textarea component (NOT INSTALLED - needs: npx shadcn add textarea)

architecture.constraint: Next.js App Router: Server Components for data fetching, Client Components for interactivity
Service layer for calculations: implementation-tracker.ts handles all before/after metrics logic
Business isolation: All queries must filter by userId → businessId → siteId for data privacy
Server Actions for mutations: Use src/actions/recommendations.ts pattern with auth verification

data.constraint: Session queries use createdAt with date range filtering (7-day windows)
All metrics calculated from Session.journeyPath analysis (no direct Session-to-Order linking)
Date manipulation uses date-fns library (subDays, addDays, differenceInDays)
Performance: Metrics calculation must complete in <500ms (NFR001)

ui.constraint: Use shadcn/ui components: Card, Badge, Textarea
Bold Purple theme: #7c3aed for primary, semantic colors for trends (green #10b981, red #ef4444, amber #fbbf24)
WCAG AA compliance: 4.5:1 contrast ratio, keyboard navigation, ARIA labels, text labels not color alone
Responsive layout: stacked on mobile, side-by-side on desktop

testing.constraint: Maintain zero TypeScript errors standard - run npm run build before completion
Unit tests use journeyPath patterns (not non-existent fields)
Integration tests in tests/integration/dashboard/ using Vitest 4.0
Test data privacy: business isolation in all queries

interface.name: calculateBeforeMetrics
interface.signature: async function calculateBeforeMetrics(siteId: string, implementedAt: Date): Promise<MetricsData>

interface.name: calculateAfterMetrics
interface.signature: async function calculateAfterMetrics(siteId: string, implementedAt: Date): Promise<MetricsData>

interface.name: calculateMetricChange
interface.signature: function calculateMetricChange(before: number, after: number): ChangeMetric

interface.name: updateImplementationNotes
interface.signature: async function updateImplementationNotes(recommendationId: string, notes: string): Promise<ActionResult<Recommendation>>

interface.name: prisma.session.findMany
interface.signature: findMany({ where: { siteId, createdAt: { gte, lt } } })

interface.name: prisma.recommendation.findMany
interface.signature: findMany({ where: { businessId, status: "IMPLEMENTED" }, orderBy: { implementedAt: "desc" } })

tests.standards: Testing follows the pyramid model with Vitest 4.0 for unit/integration tests and Playwright 1.56.1 for E2E. Unit tests target 80%+ coverage for critical services (implementation-tracker.ts). Integration tests verify Server Actions, service layer integration, and database operations. All tests use test database (TEST_DATABASE_URL) with fixtures and clearDatabase() helper. Tests must use Session.journeyPath patterns for metrics calculation. Build validation critical: maintain zero TypeScript errors, run npm run build before story completion.

test-idea.description: Integration: Query recommendations filtered by IMPLEMENTED status
test-idea.approach: Create test business with recommendations in various statuses. Query with status=IMPLEMENTED filter. Verify only IMPLEMENTED recommendations returned, sorted by implementedAt DESC

test-idea.description: Unit: Calculate before metrics from session data
test-idea.approach: Mock sessions with journeyPath arrays in 7-day period before implementedAt. Test conversion rate calculation (converted/total). Test cart abandonment (cart pages - checkout pages / cart pages). Verify confidence levels based on session count

test-idea.description: Unit: Calculate after metrics from session data
test-idea.approach: Mock sessions with journeyPath in 7-day period after implementedAt. Calculate same metrics as before. Verify date range filtering works correctly with subDays/addDays

test-idea.description: Unit: Calculate metric change with trend direction
test-idea.approach: Test scenarios: positive change (>5% = positive trend), negative change (<-5% = negative trend), neutral change (-5% to +5% = no change). Verify formatted output with +/- signs and colors

test-idea.description: Integration: Edge case - recommendation implemented <7 days ago
test-idea.approach: Create recommendation with implementedAt 3 days ago. Verify status shows "Too early to measure". Confirm after metrics query returns insufficient data message

test-idea.description: Integration: Edge case - insufficient session data (<100 sessions)
test-idea.approach: Create recommendation with implementedAt, but only 20 sessions in before period. Verify confidence level set to LOW. Display "Insufficient data" warning to user
Test updateImplementationNotes Server Action. Create note, update existing note, verify 500 char limit validation. Test auth verification (only owner can update)

Seed test data: recommendation implemented 14 days ago, mock sessions before/after with known conversion rates. Calculate metrics, verify change percentage matches expected. Test business isolation (can't see other business data)
